propositions: output_mode blanket-forces PromptedOutput whenever thinking=True based on stale Anthropic 400 rationale, but measured testing shows native outputConfig with thinking succeeds on supported models.
A new native_output_with_thinking capability field must gate native output under thinking, defaulting to False to preserve current behavior until capability rows are populated with measured data.

The output_mode guard should select NativeOutput when native_structured_output AND (not thinking OR native_output_with_thinking), enabling native output on measured-safe thinking cells while keeping prompted path as fallback.
Tools paired with thinking suppress tool calling; this is why structured_run.py:181 is the no-tools single-shot path and explains the structural scoping, not a guard parameter.
